title: Step 1 - K-Means Clustering in R: Importing & Exploring Segmentation Data

cues.en: -: Hello and welcome to this R tutorial.
cues.zh: 講師：大家好，歡迎來到這堂 R 教學。

cues.en: In this tutorial, we are going to solve our business problem using the K-means algorithm in R.
cues.zh: 這堂課要用 R 中的 K-means 演算法，解決我們的商業問題。

cues.en: So let's start by setting our working directory.
cues.zh: 先設定工作目錄。

cues.en: So we go to session set working directory and we click on choose directory.
cues.zh: 進入 Session、Set Working Directory，再點 Choose Directory。

cues.en: Then we pick our folder, Machine Learning A-Z, section K-Means Clustering, and we click on open.
cues.zh: 選取 Machine Learning A-Z 裡的 K-Means Clustering 資料夾，再按 Open。

cues.en: Okay, now the first step is to import the mall dataset.
cues.zh: 好，第一步匯入購物中心資料集。

cues.en: So let's introduce a new code section with the comment importing the mall dataset.
cues.zh: 先用註解「匯入購物中心資料集」，建立新的程式碼區段。

cues.en: And we import our dataset by typing dataset, left arrow read.csv, and in parenthesis mall.csv.
cues.zh: 輸入 dataset、向左箭頭、read.csv，括號中填入 mall.csv，以匯入資料集。

cues.en: Okay, let's select this line and hit control command plus enter to execute.
cues.zh: 選取這一行，按 Ctrl 或 Command 加 Enter 執行。

cues.en: And our dataset is now imported.
cues.zh: 資料集現在已經匯入。

cues.en: Let's click on it to see it.
cues.zh: 點一下來看看。

cues.en: Okay, so let's re-explain what the mall dataset is about and what our mission is.
cues.zh: 好，再說明一下購物中心資料集的內容，以及我們的任務。

cues.en: There is a big mall in a specific city that contains informations of its clients, the clients that subscribe to the membership card.
cues.zh: 某個城市有一家大型購物中心，保存了顧客資訊，也就是申辦會員卡的那些顧客。

cues.en: When the clients subscribe to the card they provided their information like their gender, their age, and their annual income.
cues.zh: 顧客申辦會員卡時，提供了性別、年齡、年收入等資訊。

cues.en: And because they have this card they use it to buy all sorts of things in the mall and therefore the mall has the purchase history of each of its client member.
cues.zh: 因為他們用這張卡在購物中心購買各種商品，所以購物中心掌握每位會員顧客的購買紀錄。

cues.en: And that's how they obtain the last column here which is a spending score.
cues.zh: 最後這一欄消費分數，就是這樣得到的。

cues.en: So as a reminder, the spending score is a score that the mall computed for each of their client based on several criteria, including, for example, their income the number of times per week they show up in the mall
cues.zh: 提醒一下，消費分數是購物中心根據數項條件為每位顧客計算的分數，例如收入、每週來購物中心的次數，

cues.en: and of course the amount of dollars they spent in a year.
cues.zh: 當然也包括一年花費的金額。

cues.en: And based on all this they computed this metric that takes values between one and a hundred so that the closer the spending score is to one and the less decline spends and the closer
cues.zh: 根據這些資料，他們算出這個數值介於 1 到 100 的指標，消費分數越接近 1，代表顧客花得越少；

cues.en: the spending score is to a hundred, the more client spends.
cues.zh: 越接近 100，代表顧客花得越多。

cues.en: And eventually, after collecting this dataset the mall company hired you as a Machine Learning Scientist to segment their clients into different groups based
cues.zh: 最後，蒐集這個資料集之後，購物中心聘請你擔任機器學習科學家，根據兩個指標將顧客區隔成不同群組，

cues.en: on these two metrics, the annual income and the spending score.
cues.zh: 也就是年收入與消費分數。

cues.en: And since the mall has no idea of what this client segments might be, this is typically a clustering problem because we don't know the answers.
cues.zh: 由於購物中心完全不知道顧客區隔會是什麼，這就是典型的分群問題，因為我們不知道答案。

cues.en: So now, let's start our mission and use the K-means algorithm to find out what those clusters of clients might be.
cues.zh: 現在開始任務，用 K-means 演算法找出可能有哪些顧客群組。

cues.en: So here we just imported the dataset and now let's create a variable X that will only contain the two columns we are interested in, the annual income and the spending score.
cues.zh: 剛才匯入了資料集，現在建立變數 X，只包含我們感興趣的兩欄：年收入與消費分數。

cues.en: So here we write X left arrow dataset, and then in square brackets we're gonna put the two indexes of our two columns of interest.
cues.zh: 輸入 X、向左箭頭、dataset，再在方括號中放入這兩欄的索引。

cues.en: That is if we go to dataset since indexes and R start at one, the indexes of our two columns, annual income and spending score are four and five.
cues.zh: 查看 dataset，由於 R 的索引從 1 開始，年收入與消費分數這兩欄的索引是 4 和 5。

cues.en: So here in the square brackets we put 4:5 which means that we go from four to five.
cues.zh: 所以在方括號中輸入 4:5，表示從 4 到 5。

cues.en: Okay, let's select this line of code and execute it.
cues.zh: 好，選取這行程式碼並執行。

cues.en: Perfect, it created the array X of our two columns which we can visualize here by clicking on X.
cues.zh: 很好，這就建立了包含兩欄的 X 陣列，點一下 X 就能查看。

cues.en: All right, now we have all our data well imported and well prepared and we are ready to move on to the next step.
cues.zh: 現在所有資料都匯入並準備好了，可以進入下一步。

cues.en: And that's when things start to get interesting.
cues.zh: 有趣的地方開始了。

cues.en: Indeed, right now we are going to start using K-means.
cues.zh: 現在要開始使用 K-means。

cues.en: So remember when we use K-means we have to specify the number of clusters but the problem here is that we have no idea of how many clusters of clients we are looking for.
cues.zh: 記得使用 K-means 時必須指定群組數量，但問題是，我們不知道要找幾個顧客群組。

cues.en: So we could fit K-means several times on our dataset with different numbers of clusters to test different outcomes.
cues.zh: 可以用不同群組數量，在資料集上多次擬合 K-means，測試不同結果。

cues.en: However, there is a much faster way that allows us to find the optimal number of clusters to use with K-means for our problem.
cues.zh: 不過有個快得多的方法，能找出這個問題中 K-means 的最佳群組數量。

cues.en: And we are, of course, gonna use the elbow method.
cues.zh: 當然，就是手肘法。

cues.en: So let's introduce a new section with the comment using the elbow method to find the optimal number of clusters.
cues.zh: 用註解「使用手肘法找出最佳群組數量」，建立新的區段。

cues.en: And in this code section we are gonna make a for loop, to plot our elbow method chart.
cues.zh: 這個程式碼區段裡會寫一個 for 迴圈，來畫手肘法圖表。

cues.en: So since there are random factors in K-means we can obtain slightly different results by using K-means several times.
cues.zh: K-means 有隨機因素，因此多次使用可能得到略有不同的結果。

cues.en: So in order to all get the same results we are gonna set the same seed.
cues.zh: 為了讓大家得到相同結果，要設定相同的種子值。

cues.en: And to do this we type set.seed, and then in parenthesis we can pick whatever number we like.
cues.zh: 輸入 set.seed，括號裡可以選任何喜歡的數字。

cues.en: Let's pick six.
cues.zh: 我們選 6。

cues.en: Then we are going to use a for loop to compute some different within-cluster sum of squares four different numbers of clusters.
cues.zh: 接著用 for 迴圈，計算不同群組數量的群內平方和。

cues.en: And we are gonna place the different within-cluster sum of squares in a vector.
cues.zh: 並把各個群內平方和放進向量。

cues.en: So let's start by initializing this vector by typing WCSS, left arrow, vector and empty parenthesis.
cues.zh: 先初始化這個向量，輸入 wcss、向左箭頭、vector，再加空括號。

cues.en: So that just initialized an empty vector.
cues.zh: 這樣就初始化了一個空向量。

cues.en: And now we're gonna use the for loop to populate it with the different within-cluster sum of squares.
cues.zh: 接著用 for 迴圈填入各個群內平方和。

cues.en: So let's write for.
cues.zh: 輸入 for。

cues.en: And in parenthesis I in 1:10.
cues.zh: 括號中寫 i in 1:10。

cues.en: So in for loops in R the lower bound and the upper bound are included.
cues.zh: R 的 for 迴圈包含下限與上限。

cues.en: So here that means that I is gonna take the values from 1 to 10 included.
cues.zh: 所以這裡表示 i 會取從 1 到 10 的值，包含 10。

cues.en: And then at each iteration we directly compute the within-cluster sum of squares for each number I of clusters by writing sum.
cues.zh: 每次迭代時，都直接計算 i 個群組的群內平方和，先寫 sum。

cues.en: And in parenthesis, K-means XI to fit the K means algorithm to our dataset X with I clusters.
cues.zh: 括號中寫 kmeans(X, i)，把有 i 個群組的 K-means 演算法擬合到資料集 X。

cues.en: And by doing that, we actually created an object of the class K-means in R.
cues.zh: 這樣其實就建立了 R 中 kmeans 類別的物件。

cues.en: And if we select K-means here press F1 and then scroll down to value.
cues.zh: 選取這裡的 kmeans，按 F1，再往下捲到 Value。

cues.en: We see that this class has a attribute called withinss that computes the within-cluster sum of squares.
cues.zh: 可以看到這個類別有一個叫 withinss 的屬性，用來計算群內平方和。

cues.en: So let's of course use it and type K-means XI and then $withinss.
cues.zh: 當然就使用它，輸入 kmeans(X, i)，再加上 $withinss。

cues.en: All right, now thanks to this loop the WCSS vector is populated with the 10 different within-cluster sum of squares.
cues.zh: 好，透過這個迴圈，wcss 向量就填入了 10 個不同的群內平方和，

cues.en: For the 10 numbers of clusters, one to 10.
cues.zh: 分別對應 1 到 10 這十種群組數量。

cues.en: Perfect, so now all we have to do left is plot the graph.
cues.zh: 很好，現在剩下只要畫圖。

cues.en: So we type plot, and in parenthesis we first input the X values, that means one to 10, then the Y values WCSS.
cues.zh: 輸入 plot，括號裡先放 X 值，也就是 1 到 10，再放 Y 值 wcss。

cues.en: Okay, then let's select plot and press F1.
cues.zh: 接著選取 plot，按 F1。

cues.en: We can specify a type of plot.
cues.zh: 可以指定繪圖類型。

cues.en: P to have only points, L to have only lines, and B for both.
cues.zh: p 代表只畫點，l 代表只畫線，b 代表兩者都畫。

cues.en: And we are gonna choose both.
cues.zh: 我們選兩者都畫。

cues.en: So B, then let's give a title to our plot by typing main equals spaced and in parenthesis clusters of clients.
cues.zh: 所以是 b；接著用 main 等於，並在引號中填入「顧客群組」，為圖表加上標題。

cues.en: Then we can give a name to our X label.
cues.zh: 再為 X 軸標籤取名。

cues.en: So let's input X lab equals number of clusters and we give a name to our Y axis Y lab equals WCSS.
cues.zh: 輸入 xlab 等於「群組數量」，並把 Y 軸名稱 ylab 設為 WCSS。
